name: Mercenaries
summary: Mercenaries is a bounty contract issued by Magistrate Bluntnose in Thelsamar to cull the encroaching Mo'grosh ogres in northeastern Loch Modan. With military reinforcements from Ironforge bogged down in months of bureaucratic delay, the magistrate is forced to hire passing adventurers to protect the valley's vulnerable settlements, excavations, and the vital Stonewrought Dam.

sections.title: Ironforge's Slow Wheels
sections.body: Thelsamar is feeling the sting of dwarven bureaucracy. It took two full months for Ironforge to even promise a handful of soldiers to bolster Loch Modan's local defense, and another two months before those troops are slated to arrive. With town guards stretched to their limits, Magistrate Bluntnose cannot afford to wait four months while hostile forces mass just beyond the valley's borders.

sections.title: The Threat in the Hills
sections.body: The Mo'grosh ogres have fortified an encampment in the hills northeast of the loch. Their growing presence jeopardizes not just the town of Thelsamar, but the Ironband Excavation Site and the Stonewrought Dam itself. Should the dam be attacked or compromised, the devastation downstream would be catastrophic. Lacking official mountaineer detachments, Bluntnose has turned to freelance mercenaries to thin out the ogre ranks and buy the valley time against both ogres and troggs.

faq.q: Why is Magistrate Bluntnose hiring mercenaries instead of using guards?
faq.answer: Ironforge has been agonizingly slow to respond to Loch Modan's pleas for aid. It took two months for the Senate to approve sending even a handful of soldiers, and another two months until they actually arrive. Facing immediate threats to Thelsamar, the dam, and local dig sites, Bluntnose has no choice but to pay independent adventurers.

faq.q: Where are the Mo'grosh ogres located?
faq.answer: The Mo'grosh ogres inhabit the Mo'grosh Stronghold, situated in the rugged bluffs and hills northeast of Loch Modan's great lake.

faq.q: Why is the Stonewrought Dam considered in danger?
faq.answer: The Stonewrought Dam regulates the entire lake and is an architectural jewel of the dwarves. With military defense practically nonexistent and the Mo'grosh ogres establishing a camp nearby, Bluntnose fears an organized raid could damage or sabotage the massive structure, unleashing catastrophic floods.

faq.q: What other threats does Thelsamar face alongside the ogres?
faq.answer: Troggs have erupted across the loch from underground ruins and excavations. Bluntnose considers them a massive menace, but the brute strength of the nearby ogre stronghold forces him to hire fighters to push back the Mo'grosh so the local guard can concentrate on the trogg incursions.

angles.text: Seeing the crown jewel of dwarven engineering—the Stonewrought Dam—left unguarded due to Ironforge red tape makes Bluntnose's call to arms a personal matter for any mountaineer or traveler from the capital.
Loch Modan forms a crucial corridor between Khaz Modan and the northern kingdoms; letting it fall into chaos under ogre raids threatens Alliance supply lines across the Eastern Kingdoms.
